args.stdin: SELECT v.product_sku, CASE WHEN v.record_path LIKE '/%' THEN v.record_path ELSE '/catalog/' || v.record_path END AS record_path FROM product_variants v WHERE LOWER(TRIM(v.brand)) = LOWER(TRIM(:claimed_brand)) AND LOWER(TRIM(v.series)) LIKE '%crystal grip%' AND LOWER(TRIM(v.model)) LIKE '%2zq-d83%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = v.product_sku AND LOWER(TRIM(p.property_key)) = 'adhesive_type' AND LOWER(TRIM(p.property_value_text)) = LOWER(TRIM(:claimed_adhesive_type))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p2 WHERE p2.product_sku = v.product_sku AND LOWER(TRIM(p2.property_key)) = 'color_family' AND LOWER(TRIM(p2.property_value_text)) = LOWER(TRIM(:claimed_color_family))) LIMIT 5
